tasks.spec:
You are a code worker. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. Edit files here directly. Do NOT git commit, push or touch .git. Do NOT run a formatter on YAML or markdown. You own only data/stories/continuity-initiative/plot.md and files under tests/. Edit nothing else. Before you edit, read docs/world-model-grounding.md ("Things": place every declared item in the scene where it appears; a Details line that names a declared item needs the item placed in that scene).

PROBLEM. PR 565 declared the item `emergency_surface_gates` (name 'emergency surface gates', alias 'surface gates', fixed) in world.yaml and put it only in scene 3C (plot.md, Scene 3C frontmatter: item_ids and item_placements: emergency_surface_gates: {parent: facility_escape}). The 3A and 3B scenes also talk about the gates: the 3A Details line names 'emergency surface gates', the senior official's authorization releases them, and players in 3A and 3B type 'Open the emergency surface gates.' / 'Reach the emergency surface gates.'. Because the item is declared but not in those scenes, narration that mentions it is rejected with `narration mentions an unavailable entity 'emergency surface gates'` (5 rejected turns in the last live run: 3A three, 3B two). The 3A player lost 3 of 15 turns to it.

FIX. In plot.md add `emergency_surface_gates` to the `item_ids` list of Scene 3A and Scene 3B, and add the placement `emergency_surface_gates: {parent: facility_escape}` to the `item_placements` of both (same parent as 3C; 'things stay where they were left'). Do not add a `text:`. Change nothing else in plot.md: no prose, no other scene. Do not touch world.yaml or any other data file.

TESTS. Add tests/test_surface_gates_scope.py (hermetic, no live worker) with at least these tests: (1) scenes 3A, 3B and 3C list and place the item, and scenes 1A to 2C do not; (2) narration in a runtime state at 3A accepts a segment that says 'Kristin looks at the emergency surface gates.' and one that says 'The surface gates are shut.'; the same for 3B; use RuntimeEngine/RuntimeState as tests/test_narration_character_names.py does, with state.current_scene_id set to the scene and the scene entry fact asserted the way tests/test_resolution_cascade.py _state_3c does; (3) the same sentence in scene 1A is still rejected with the unavailable-entity or known-term code that the engine raises today (run it first to see the real code; this proves the fix did not open the name everywhere). If (3) is accepted today before your change, do not invent a rejection: report it in notes.md.

HOW TO RUN TESTS. In this sandbox `uv run` cannot write its cache or download. Use the main checkout's environment but import THIS worktree's code: `PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider`. First run `PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -c "import storygame;print(storygame.__file__)"` and confirm the path is inside your working directory; if not, say so in notes.md. Run ruff with the same interpreter (`-m ruff check --fix .` then `-m ruff format .`); it must not touch YAML or markdown. Run the full suite once at the end. If an existing test fails because 3A or 3B now carry the item (for example a prompt-capture or placement count), report it in notes.md and change an assertion only where the new placement requires it, keeping its intent.

OUTPUT. Write notes.md at the worktree root: lines changed, tests added, any existing assertion changed and why, final suite counts. Do not claim the suite passes unless you ran it and saw it pass.
